WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 1 AS first_week, 4 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    CROSS JOIN params
    CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st   ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id || '-' || d.fiscal_week) AS store_weeks, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) AS stores
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d   ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
)

SELECT d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) distinct_ids, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) distinct_rl, SUM(f.net_amount) net, COUNT(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) loads, MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) mn, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE (d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week<=4) OR (d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week<=4) GROUP BY 1

WITH mine AS (
  SELECT business_date, store_id, SUM(v) v FROM (
    SELECT f.sale_date business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount v FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id<900
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id<900) GROUP BY 1,2),
ctl AS (SELECT business_date, store_id, net_sales c FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id<900)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) store_days, SUM(COALESCE(m.v,0)) mine, SUM(COALESCE(c.c,0)) ctl, SUM(COALESCE(m.v,0))-SUM(COALESCE(c.c,0)) gap,
  SUM(CASE WHEN abs(COALESCE(m.v,0)-COALESCE(c.c,0))>0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatched_store_days
FROM (SELECT business_date, store_id FROM mine UNION SELECT business_date, store_id FROM ctl) k
LEFT JOIN mine m USING (business_date, store_id) LEFT JOIN ctl c USING (business_date, store_id)
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=k.business_date
WHERE (d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week<=4) OR (d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_week<=4)
GROUP BY 1

WITH days AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.calendar_date, d.is_trading_day, s.store_id
  FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id<900) s
  WHERE (d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')) AND d.fiscal_week<=4),
sales AS (SELECT business_date, store_id, net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales)
SELECT days.fiscal_year, days.store_id, days.calendar_date, days.is_trading_day, s.net_sales
FROM days LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.business_date=days.calendar_date AND s.store_id=days.store_id
WHERE (days.is_trading_day AND (s.net_sales IS NULL OR s.net_sales<=0)) OR (NOT days.is_trading_day AND s.net_sales IS NOT NULL AND s.net_sales<>0)
ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH params AS (
    SELECT 'FY2026/27' AS ty_year, 'FY2025/26' AS ly_year, 1 AS first_week, 4 AS last_week
),
range_start AS (
    SELECT MIN(d.calendar_date) AS first_day FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND d.fiscal_week = params.first_week
),
weeks AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.fiscal_week_start_date, d.fiscal_week_end_date
    FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, w.fiscal_year, w.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= w.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= w.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                           WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                             AND c.closure_start_date <= w.fiscal_week_end_date
                             AND c.closure_end_date >= w.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st CROSS JOIN weeks w
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty CROSS JOIN params CROSS JOIN range_start
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
    JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= range_start.first_day - 364)
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN (params.ty_year, params.ly_year)
      AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN params.first_week AND LEAST(params.last_week, 52)
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year
)
SELECT ty.fiscal_year, 1 AS fiscal_period, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct
FROM lfl_sales ty CROSS JOIN params JOIN lfl_sales ly ON ly.fiscal_year = params.ly_year
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = params.ty_year
